analysis.summary: Amazon reported Q4 2025 revenue of $213.4 billion, up 12% year-over-year, with operating income of $25 billion. AWS accelerated growth to 24%, reaching a $142 billion annualized run rate, with custom chips (Graviton and Trainium) generating over $10 billion annually. The company is investing heavily in AI, custom silicon, low earth orbit satellites, and quick commerce. Key announcements include new partnerships with OpenAI, Visa, and others, plus launches of Nova Forge for custom model training and Bedrock AgentCore for enterprise AI deployment.
risks: Unpredictable demand for goods and services

Tariff and trade policies affecting operations

Competition in AI and cloud services markets

keyPoints: Revenue of $213.4 billion, up 12% year-over-year excluding FX impact
AWS growth accelerated to 24%, fastest in 13 quarters
AWS annualized run rate reached $142 billion
Custom chips business (Graviton and Trainium) over $10 billion annual revenue run rate with triple-digit growth
Bedrock multibillion-dollar annualized run rate with 60% quarter-over-quarter customer spend growth
Trainium2 chips landed over 1.4 million units, fastest ramping chip launch ever
Launched Nova Forge enabling early-stage custom model training with proprietary data
Launched Bedrock AgentCore for enterprise AI agent deployment
Kiro autonomous coding agent grew 150% quarter-over-quarter
